# GarageSaarthi – Garage Management Software for Modern Workshops

GarageSaarthi is an all-in-one garage management software platform built for auto workshops, car service centers, bike repair shops, and multi-branch garages across India. It helps workshop owners digitize operations, manage job cards, billing, inventory, customer history, staff, and finances — all from one platform.

## Key Features

- [Job Card Management](https://www.garagesaarthi.com/solutions/garage-job-card-software) – Create, assign, and track vehicle job cards digitally.
- [GST Billing Software](https://www.garagesaarthi.com/solutions/garage-billing-software) – Auto-generate GST-compliant invoices and estimates.
- [Inventory Management](https://www.garagesaarthi.com/solutions/garage-inventory-software) – Track spare parts stock levels and reorder alerts.
- [Service Reminder Software](https://www.garagesaarthi.com/solutions/service-reminder-software) – Auto-send WhatsApp/SMS reminders for next service due.
- [CRM & Customer Management](https://www.garagesaarthi.com/solutions/garage-crm-software) – Full vehicle and customer history at a glance.
- [Multi-Branch Management](https://www.garagesaarthi.com/solutions/multi-branch-garage-software) – Centralized control across multiple garage locations.
- [Staff & Mechanic Management](https://www.garagesaarthi.com/solutions/garage-attendance-software) – Track attendance, payroll, and productivity.
- [Finance & Accounting](https://www.garagesaarthi.com/solutions/garage-accounting-software) – Monitor P&L, expenses, and CA-ready reports.
- [Real-Time Dashboard](https://www.garagesaarthi.com/features/workshop-management-dashboard) – Live insights into revenue, jobs, and collections.
- [WhatsApp Notifications](https://www.garagesaarthi.com/solutions/garage-whatsapp-notification-software) – Auto-send bookings, invoices, and alerts via WhatsApp.

## About

GarageSaarthi is designed specifically for the Indian automotive aftermarket. It supports Hindi and regional languages, GST compliance, UPI payments, and Android mobile access for on-the-go garage management.
